consequence.statement: No operational consequence: the new field is optional and only takes effect when set; existing policies and their context entries continue to work unchanged, and environments using apiCall context entries gain the ability to specify a fallback value.
consequence.remediation: Optionally set the apiCall.default field on API call context entries that should fall back to a default value when the API server returns an error.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds an optional apiCall.default field to API call context entries (spec.rules[].context[].apiCall.default on ClusterPolicy and Policy, mirrored under the same path in v2beta1 and under spec.context[].apiCall.default on CleanupPolicy and ClusterCleanupPolicy) that provides a fallback value for the context entry when the API server returns an error.
